prompt:

Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — nag (v.唠叨不休): An adult repeatedly reminds a distracted partner to tidy a messy desk, persistent talking gestures, partner looking weary.
TOP RIGHT — pollution (n.污染): A river beside an industrial area contains discolored water and scattered litter, grey smoke rises in distance, environmental damage clear.
BOTTOM LEFT — overpopulated (a.人口多的): A very crowded neighborhood with many people squeezed into a small street and tightly packed apartment buildings.
BOTTOM RIGHT — over-industrialized (a.过度工业化的): Factories, smokestacks and warehouses cover nearly all of a valley, very little greenery remains.
CRITICAL SAFE COMPOSITION: Make subjects SMALLER than the style reference. Every subject fits within central 65% of its own quadrant, with large 20% white margins on all sides. Bottom-row subjects including heads and thought bubbles begin BELOW 58% of entire canvas height; top subjects end ABOVE 42%. Keep central horizontal 42–58% totally blank white. No head, limb, object or speech bubble crosses either exact 50% midline.
review_notes: Four cells visually checked: repeated scolding by a messy desk, polluted river and smoke, crowded residential street, and factories covering a valley. Each has the intended action or state and safe white separation.
